d:
Pakistan’s Environment Minister Musadik Masood Malik visited New Delhi to attend the SCO Civilizational Dialogue. But when journalists questioned him about terrorism and the Indus Waters Treaty, his responses appeared markedly different from his earlier statements in Pakistan. While he called for dialogue based on evidence, he also said Pakistan was ready to discuss the water treaty if India extended an invitation. What changed in Malik’s tone, and what does it reveal about India-Pakistan relations?
